verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU, NPU and memory subsystem). Acting as an MCP client that plugs in tool servers is a software-agent role, so this story is a category error for a chip. Nothing in the evidence shows the product itself shipping MCP client functionality: the AI Hub, GenieX and SDK items cover model optimization and deployment, not MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
